how: We read the website of every Portland wedding planner listed on Lazo (74 listings, 59 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: venues that also sell coordination, DJ and photo-booth companies, officiants, a barn venue and a videographer bundle listed as planners. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Full planning, partial, or day-of only? Ask what each tier includes in hours and in meetings.
Which Gorge, wine country or Vancouver venues have you worked this year, and what are their rain plans?
Who is on site on the wedding day, the planner you hired or an associate?

picks.name: Bridal Bliss
picks.blurb: Full-service planning in Portland, Seattle and Bend since 2002. Bridal Bliss describes itself as innovative coordinators willing to go the extra mile, with inclusivity and a fresh perspective on event design as the things that set it apart.

picks.name: Your Perfect Bridesmaid
picks.blurb: A team of wedding planners and designers with bases in Portland, Seattle and Phoenix, serving Oregon, Washington and Arizona. YPB's stated goal is simple: that you and your loved ones are fully present on the day while the organization is handled for you.

picks.name: Amore Coordination
picks.blurb: Amy Elizabeth Ha has stood beside couples at more than 230 weddings over ten-plus years and plans toward days where the couple felt present and cared for, not the ones with the biggest budgets. Amore Coordination offers transparent packages scaled to how much support you want, for couples of all backgrounds.

picks.name: Events By Emily
picks.blurb: Events for the alternative: Events By Emily specializes in nontraditional weddings and describes its packages as everything you need for a bash, a celebration, or a melding of weirdness. Packages are published as a starting point, with custom options on request.

picks.name: Jaime Ta Creative
picks.blurb: An inclusive Portland wedding and event planner who also works San Diego, currently booking weddings, events and elopements for 2027. Jaime Ta's aim is to make planning fun rather than stressful, and support includes unlimited email consultations.

picks.name: EVENTCRACKER
picks.blurb: EventCracker is a multicultural wedding specialist based in Beaverton, planning in Oregon, Washington and California, from the Columbia River Gorge to vineyard settings. The site speaks directly to couples juggling cultural traditions and family expectations, with full-service planning, coordination and design.

picks.name: Aisle Ready Events
picks.blurb: Jodie, the self-described wedding dream planner and chaos coordinator behind Aisle Ready Events, does luxury planning and design for large and small weddings, including multicultural ones. Every couple gets a comprehensive wedding checklist and planning calendar built around their date.

picks.name: Kelsey Timberlake Events
picks.blurb: Since 2015 Kelsey Timberlake Events has deliberately taken on a limited number of luxury events per year so each gets undivided attention, from logistics to design and decor. Full-service planning and design for discerning couples, in Oregon and at destinations worldwide.

picks.name: Higher Love Event Co.
picks.blurb: Kylie, a native Oregonian with nearly seven years in venue management, catering sales and luxury coordination, built Higher Love Event Co. in St. Johns around fixed-scope packages, published pricing and pre-designed decor collections. The pitch is Portland wedding planning without the overwhelm.

picks.name: WE Plan It
picks.blurb: A full-service planning, design and coordination studio in Vancouver, Washington that works Portland, Seattle and beyond. WE Plan It promises to take the ordinary and create extraordinary, with refinement as its stated passion.

picks.name: Gorge Wedding Concierge
picks.blurb: Jen brings nearly two decades in the wedding industry, a photographer's eye and deep knowledge of the Columbia River Gorge to Gorge Wedding Concierge, which she founded to make planning there less overwhelming. She leads planning while a coordination team runs the day, and the company also manages events at Mt. Hood Organic Farms.

picks.name: LoveNotes
picks.blurb: A Hood River coordinator who sees herself as a coach for couples, with coordination services that put no time limit on working together. LoveNotes has planned for couples from around the world who chose her hometown to marry, and lists pre-planning services separately on the site.
